C.why: Dome boulder pauldrons are the clearest outline of the wave and read as carved statue from pitch 50; olive bronze with gold trim and stone face plate.
C.fix: Replace the tan plank crest with a wide sun-gold crest; gold bosses on the domes; more pale stone to separate from fenscale.

A.why: Sun-ray crest is a real idea and the slab pauldrons give mass, but the rays are hairline and the body reads dark olive.
A.fix: Fewer, thicker, longer gold rays fanned behind the helm; lighter warmer bronze; stone tops on both pauldrons.

F.why: Big back disc is a strong read from the back-facing ARPG camera, but it is grey (iron) and the stacked helm reads as a top hat.
F.fix: Make the disc bronze-gold with a sun rim; one massive simple helm instead of stacked boxes; drop chest clutter.

D.why: Most statue-like, with pale stone blocks and massive shoulders, but the bronze and the sun gold are missing and every part is a box.
D.fix: Bring green-bronze back on arms, greaves and belt; add one non-box shape (crest or sun gorget); gold rings.

E.why: Winged helm and gold bands read, but it reads samurai, and the brown back tabard drifts towards leather.
E.fix: Thicker, simpler bronze crest instead of kabuto horns; tabard to bronze or stone; lighter tone.

B.why: Verdigris teal is apt bronze, but there is no silhouette idea, and the teal risks reading as fenscale.
B.fix: Add one strong shape; warm the hue towards bronze; matched pauldrons; drop the visor slash lines.

notes: No set fails on fit; all hold on the slim avatar. The wave's common weakness is too little sun gold and too much dark olive, which risks fenscale and Reaver from above. The best ideas to combine: C's domes, A's sun crest (thickened) and F's back disc (in gold). D shows the pale-stone share the others lack.
